builders.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI

tweets.text:
At Box, we've been testing Gemini 4 Argon on our Box AI Complex Work eval for the past week. It's a huge upgrade over Gemini 3.1 Pro, jumping by 14 percentage points across all our tests, and firmly at the frontier. 

In our evaluation, we give the Box Agent (using Gemini 4 Argon) a variety of complex enterprise tasks involving enterprise documents in a range of industries. These tasks approximate the kind of hard, time-consuming work that knowledge workers do every day with their enterprise content. Gemini 4 is a huge leap on effectively every dimension of this work.

Gemini 4 is far more capable on math, logic, analytics, and deep knowledge of a variety of business domains. It also works far harder to complete tasks fully without stopping short of the desired result. This is incredibly important for complex enterprise workflows that depend on robust task execution.

Here are some example wins that we saw to put the improvements in perspective:

* Financial services (+18 points): a funding-gap analysis for a family-owned company, where the brief spelled out every step of the projected statements, down to the interest on the bank loan and the overdraft for each year. Gemini 4 Argon built them exactly as specified, every line broken out and carried through to the funding gap. Gemini 3.1 Pro folded the interest into a single figure.

* Healthcare (+25 points): an intensive care management plan where both models spotted a dangerous potassium level and a drug interaction. Only Gemini 4 Argon went back and pulled the offending drugs from the final regimen, so its plan actually matched its own diagnosis.

* Technology (+37 points): a product performance review deciding which of two regional markets should have its cloud infrastructure optimized first. Gemini 4 Argon pulled the right month's user, retention and per-user figures for both regions and correctly flagged North America. Gemini 3.1 Pro often pulled the wrong rows, at one point reporting retention above 100%, and pointed the effort at the wrong region.

* Energy (+16 points): an energy consumption report across two facilities that had to flag any gaps in the meter data. Gemini 4 Argon consistently caught that the data center's smart meter log stops in November. Gemini 3.1 Pro often missed it, at times declaring the logs complete.

* Consumer products (+33 points): a product launch evaluation deciding which production expansion to fund. Gemini 4 Argon saw that existing inventory could bridge an early capacity gap, which made the smaller expansion viable with an earlier launch and a faster break-even. Gemini 3.1 Pro defaulted to the larger expansion and the later timeline.

Gemini 4 Argon will be available in the Box AI Studio shortly for anyone to build custom Box Agents with.

虚假的使用 AI：一有新工具就疯狂发帖推荐，实则自己根本没用过几次。

真正的使用 AI：0营销，就是闷头用，用到自己赚钱了，今天被动冲上了微博热搜第二。

今天挂在热搜上的“老干妈用 AI 一年赚 54 亿”，反差感拉满。

没错就是那瓶老干妈。

小编跑去看了下新闻和介绍，发现在前端，老干妈表现得极度“反互联网”：

前两年公司内部算清楚账，发现电商销售占比不到 5%，营销成本却能吃掉 30%，他们索性把直播团队直接解散，公众号干脆断更，彻底退回线下渠道，完全不蹭任何流量营销。

但回过头看工厂，他们是真在用 AI 搞产品，比如用 AI 算法识别辣椒好坏。

老干妈工厂在流水线上架上高速工业相机，算法实时扫描传送带，一旦识别出有黑斑或霉变的辣椒，气流装置立刻精准把坏辣椒吹走，将关键工序的不良率压到了 0.02%，顺手还把核心原料做到了 100% 可追溯追溯。

降本增效后，2025 年老干妈的营收反而逆势创下了 54 亿元的历史新高。

挺有意思的一点是，当年加密行业大谈特谈“区块链+供应链溯源”，包装了无数个落地叙事，最后大多没了下文。

结果传统工厂靠一套工业相机加 AI 视觉识别，顺便就把原料溯源和品控的问题给解决了。

用 AI 最实在的降本增效，还真不在热词炒作的聚光灯里。

The Rollup 最近与 NEAR 联合创始人 @ilblackdragon 的对话透露了一个明确的市场信号：NEAR 正在从一条单纯的底层公链，实质性地转型为全网流动性的“超级路由”。

这轮周期之所以有人将其对标以太坊，核心逻辑在于它试图通过意图（Intents）机制吃下两块增量市场：

1. 打破资产边界，做“市场中的市场” 

NEAR Intents 的定位不再局限于单纯的跨链交互，而是作为通用交易聚合层，直接将触角伸向了传统金融。通过聚合纳斯达克、纽交所等真实股票流动性，它试图让用户仅凭一个链上意图，在全网匹配到最优对手方，而不是仅谈 Web2 和 Web3。

2. 承接无头资产的链上投机主场 

对于 Quantus、Pearl 等没有中心化交易所（CEX）背书、仅在 SafeTrade 等暗池流转的纯链上资产，NEAR 正在为其提供极佳的交易深度与隐私体验。凭借这种聚合能力，https://t.co/W5LG0wL9VP 已经不再是一个简单的公链前端，而是演变成了一个能够直接对标 Druckbot 的全链投机工作台。

Mamdani is far less ideological than the typical woke. He’s an accomplished actor (literally) who can emote on demand and then return to sobriety once the cameras stop rolling.

Due to his identity, he has so much clout within his party that — like Trump — he can reshape it. He can even meet with Trump, without consequence, something that more insecure blues simply couldn’t do.

Just like Mark Carney is several standard deviations smarter than Justin Trudeau, Mamdani is far smarter than his predecessor’s predecessor De Blasio. Neither Carney nor Mamdani are the naive anarchistic wokes who actually believe the slogans.

Sure, they do both define themselves as “not MAGA”, but MAGA itself contains so many contradictory tendencies that both Carney and Mamdani could embrace a harsh Chinese abundance communism — a synthesis of abundance liberalism, symbolic anti-MAGA “communism”, and MAGA’s own desire for law-and-order — which would legitimize itself by an anti-MAGA blue nationalism, but which would otherwise be devoid of ideological content.

After all, “ICE out” means “reds out.” It’s a kind of blue nationalism that still endorses the idea of borders and deportations; it just says that blues want to deport *reds* from their territory, and implement their own immigration policies instead of having MAGAs implement them. And NYC and Canada do have the port access to run their own economies independently of DC, and have done so before in history.

Anyway, it’s possible that Mamdani one day holds up a hand, cuts off the NGO grift, and makes the crime stop…but only after he’s secured total control of the city, by “taxing the rich” and driving out every last donor who might conceivably oppose him. Mamdani is interesting. Shows a kind of Deng potential. To be clear, he’ll use leftism to tax and harass his tribal enemies till they leave town. The Curley Effect.
